reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: I love this so much . I can see a difference in my face after use. I love how my face looks the morning after I use it. Nit stucky but very hydrating.
reviews.zh: 我超愛呢款。用完之後塊面即時見到分別。第二朝起身塊面嘅狀態我好鍾意。唔黏笠但非常保濕。

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: Like it well enough but it's not as good as the moon moisturizer
reviews.zh: 幾鍾意，但就唔及 moon moisturizer 咁好。

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: perfect moisture!! I repeat this item for almost 10 times
reviews.zh: 保濕效果完美！！我已經回購接近 10 次。

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: I don't think this one is meant for me. I love that it's non-scented, but even though it's moisturizing it actually leaves me feeling drier in the areas where I don't get oily. I have combination skin so my forehead was fine, but my cheeks would feel tight and dry. Maybe it'll work for more oily skin, but just not combination skin.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款唔係為我而設。我鍾意佢冇香味，但雖然佢有保濕，喺啲唔出油嘅位置反而令我覺得更乾。我係混合性肌膚，所以額頭冇事，但面頰會覺得繃緊又乾。可能啱油性肌多啲，但就唔啱混合性肌膚。

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: I’ve been using this hydrating pot since July and I love it so much!! Is super hydrating! Love it!
reviews.zh: 由七月開始用呢罐保濕 cream，我超級鍾意！！超級保濕！好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: I’ve been using it for almost a year and I really like it! Will keep buying it for sure!
reviews.zh: 用咗差唔多一年，我真係好鍾意！一定會繼續回購！

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: This cream is so good it make my face so soft and I makes my wrinkles fade
reviews.zh: 呢款 cream 勁正，令到我塊面變得好軟，仲令我嘅皺紋淡咗。

reviews.shade: Abib Sedum Hyaluron Crème Hydrating Pot 80mL
reviews.text: I love this cream! It's moisturizing and makes my skin glow.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款 cream！佢保濕仲令皮膚有光澤。
